title: File Processing API
objective: Accept files and process them asynchronously.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: File type/size validation and access-controlled uploads
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate file type/size validation and access-controlled uploads in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Job submission and status resources
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate job submission and status resources in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Completion, failure, cancellation, and result retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate completion, failure, cancellation, and result retrieval in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Retention limits and operational logs
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate retention limits and operational logs in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: File type/size validation and access-controlled uploads
Completion, failure, cancellation, and result retrieval
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
